oracleRisk.summary: GBPA is a fixed GBP-par issuer token, not a floating NAV share or collateralized borrower position. Fiat mint and redemption quantities do not use a token price oracle; money-market reserve valuation and issuer control remain separate Backing and Control questions.

branchApplicability.rationale: Agant defines GBP 1 face-value redemption. Verified AgantTokenUpgradeable.mint accepts a nominal amount under its minter map, with no oracle, borrower health check or liquidation branch. Tempo TIP-20 similarly issues nominal token quantities with a supply-cap check; secondary-market quotes are not issuer conversion inputs.

applicability.rationale: The exact implementation mints a requested nominal quantity under the authorized minter map, and the holder claim remains fixed GBP par rather than NAV. No borrower or liquidation-price branch exists.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: All five authored deployments are issuer-native liabilities. Agant documents LayerZero OFT source-burn/destination-mint interoperability, distinct from fiat-originating native issuance. The EVM owner controls OFT peers, delegates, bridge pausing and proxy upgrades. Full active DVN/peer/limit configuration, Solana bridge program control and Tempo bridge administration are unpinned and receive no favorable quorum or limit assumptions.
